card.name: Linking words in dispensing and distribution rules
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, by, to, for, a, from) right after wholesalers, dispense, dispensed or intended. Found in REMS program rules and pharmacy bulk package text about who may dispense or distribute a drug.

modes.label: REMS distribution rules
modes.description: Small word after wholesalers or dispensed only, in restricted-program requirements.
modes.example: • Wholesalers<< and>> distributors must only distribute to certified pharmacies.

modes.label: Pharmacy bulk and compounding
modes.description: Small word after dispensing or compound in pharmacy preparation instructions.
modes.example: 2.5 Directions for Dispensing<< from>> Pharmacy Bulk Vial
